shortBio.en: The Smiths guitarist; Rickenbacker/jangle layering as 1980s UK indie default.
shortBio.zh: The Smiths 吉他手；Rickenbacker/jangle 叠层成为 80 年代英国 indie 默认。

whyHub.en: After The Smiths: Electronic, Modest Mouse, solo—guitarist as mobile indie architecture.
whyHub.zh: 离开 The Smiths 后：Electronic、Modest Mouse、独唱——吉他手作为可移动 indie 架构。

body.en:
Born 1963. Co-writes Smiths catalog with Morrissey. Leaves 1987. Later Electronic with Bernard Sumner; tours with Modest Mouse.

Hub: jangle method travels across logos; Smiths tenure is the peak citation.
body.zh:
1963 年生。与 Morrissey 合写 Smiths 目录。1987 离队。后与 Bernard Sumner 做 Electronic；与 Modest Mouse 巡演。

枢纽：jangle 方法跨 logo 流动；Smiths 任期是峰值引用。

note.en: With Bernard Sumner; project not yet in chronicle.
note.zh: 与 Bernard Sumner；项目尚未入编年史。
